controles.affirmation: Enquete antitrust chinoise : constat preliminaire de violation publie le 15 septembre 2025 (Mellanox), issues possibles penalites/restrictions reseaux
controles.verbatim_source: On September 15, 2025, China's antitrust regulators published their preliminary finding that our compliance with applicable U.S. export controls, which required us to offer degraded products to the Chinese market, discriminated unfairly against customers in the China market and therefore violated the terms of China's approval of our Mellanox acquisition... we could be subject to financial penalties, restrictions on our ability to conduct our business, restrictions or other orders regarding our networking business

controles.affirmation: Licences H200 depuis fevrier 2026 : zero revenu a date ; impossible de creer un produit competitif pour la Chine sous les regles actuelles
controles.verbatim_source: To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program ; we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China's data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government

controles.affirmation: Gouvernement americain attend 15% ou plus du revenu des ventes sous licence, sans texte publie
controles.verbatim_source: USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement

controles.affirmation: 3 clients directs = 21%, 17%, 16% (54%) au T1 FY2027 vs 2 clients 16% et 14% au T1 FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: three direct customers represented 21%, 17%, and 16% of total revenue ; sales to two direct customers represented 16 % and 14 % of total revenue
